open_points.subject: store.read_records relation arguments
open_points.text: "A call names the relation and passes the records its name mentions — a slot, a contract version, an implementation and a corpus digest, a flow, a flow version and a run, a run, an element, a flow version's node — or, for \"by status\", the status."
open_points.question: For each named relation, what is the exact required argument list and argument order?
options: Define an explicit signature per relation (exact fields, order, optionality).
Keep one generic argument bag and validate by relation name.
open_points.default_guess: Implement explicit per-relation signatures derived from each relation title, and reject any extra/missing argument as internal_error.

open_points.subject: canonical_values.fit_port_value value-size check
open_points.text: "the size bound applying to the whole value, a `many` value included"
open_points.question: Which byte representation is used to measure a JSON value's size against bounds (stored_value_bytes_max, etc.)?
options: UTF-8 length of canonical JSON bytes (JCS).
UTF-8 length of the originally received JSON text.
Runtime serializer output used by each caller/module.
open_points.default_guess: Use UTF-8 length of canonical JSON bytes (JCS) for all value size checks.

open_points.subject: service_invoker.prepare_request instance-name vs instance-facts consistency
open_points.text: "A ManifestOperation M10 with instance facts ... beside it the selected instance's name exactly as `bindings.check_binding_current` returned it, absent when none is selected"
open_points.question: If the selected instance name and the instance facts carried in ManifestOperation are inconsistent, which source is authoritative and what outcome is returned?
options: Trust ManifestOperation facts and ignore the separate selected-instance name.
Trust the selected-instance name and re-resolve/re-read facts in service_invoker.
open_points.default_guess: Treat inconsistency as internal_error (caller defect), because service_invoker should receive a coherent pair from bindings/effects.
